notes.about: new_car_probe.py fills this in. null = unknown: whatever needs it is switched off, everything else still works.
notes.protocol: ELM327 protocol id found by the probe, e.g. "6"; null = auto-detect each time (slower to connect)
notes.shift_rpm / redline_rpm: RPM where the RPM display turns amber / red: your own limit, not necessarily the engine's maximum
notes.tank_litres: from the owner's manual; needed for fuel left in litres and range
notes.engine_litres: engine size, e.g. 1.199 for 1199 cc; petrol only: backup fuel estimate from the air taken in
notes.gears.rpm_per_kmh: filled by  python car_dashboard.py --calibrate-gears  after a drive through every gear; turns on the gear display
notes.gears.gear_ratios / final_drive / tyre: optional maker specs, e.g. tyre "175/60 R15": give a gear guess before calibrating
notes.spec: optional: the maker's published peak torque and power (with rpm); marked on the DYNO graph for comparison
